text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just annoyed. Because someone decided 
to keep blowing up my phone all night."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I simply cannot believe it. To suddenly 
start honking endlessly in the middle of 
the night...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I visited all neighboring rooms that 
seemed likely to be the source of the 
noise. However, everyone responded that 
their phone wasn't ringing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it was vibrating through the 
walls from an unexpected place...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I slammed the wall in pure frustration, 
only to hear it *creak*. Honestly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems someone left for an away race and 
forgot their phone with the wrong 
settings. She couldn't rest well because 
of the constant noise...
